name: UXAgent
notes: The linked repository neuhai/uxagent holds MIT-licensed Python code run with uv and Playwright Chromium and needs an LLM API key; it links a Hugging Face dataset. The paper is arXiv 2504.09407.
summary: Usability-testing system that generates simulated user personas, has LLM agents work through a target website via a browser connector, and shows their survey answers and action logs in a result viewer.
